sentences.en: Why people fall into these categories, however, is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们为什么会落入这些类别之中仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: The category of a hurricane depends on its wind speed.
sentences.zh: 飓风的类别取决于它的风速。

sentences.en: He won the prize in the category "Best Up-and-Coming Artist".
sentences.zh: 他在“最佳新晋艺术家”类别中获得了奖项。
